replacement_credit: missed games receive replacement_average rather than zero
replacement_source: best unselected legal player after the globally optimised 368-slot annual lineup
findings: Crediting replacement scoring materially restores the value of high-average players who miss games.
The Xerri comparison becomes far more plausible even before correcting his excessively regressed conditional-average forecast.
A pure clipped above-replacement score creates a large zero tail and cannot by itself represent keeper option value for developing players.
Replacement-aware lineup contribution and future asset option value must remain separate components.
decision: Accept replacement-aware lineup contribution as the correct immediate-production quantity. Do not promote raw expected season points as keeper utility. Do not use clipped above-replacement value as the complete player value because it discards developmental option value.
